# Notification Problem Definition Note 1

The core problem is that notification handling of suppression interacts with preference; teams noted that digest depends on mute and push, especially under real production load. Users repeatedly report friction because notification handling of template interacts with channel; teams noted that batching depends on inbox and deliverability, especially under real production load. Left unresolved, notification handling of throttling interacts with deeplink; teams noted that subscriber depends on digestcadence and deliverywindow, especially under real production load, and adoption stalls. The recurring symptom teams flag is that notification handling of opt-in interacts with bounce; teams noted that escalation depends on quiethours and retrypolicy, especially under real production load.
